name: Louise McCulloch, CRS, GRI - Oregon Broker, Don Nunamaker REALTORS
comment: Reyman has painted plenty of homes for clients, friends and neighbors; he's painted the interior and exterior of my home as well. What I like best about Reyman is his eye for color; his cleanliness and organizational skills regarding the whole of the job from start to finish; and his knowledge of the best paints and materials.

name: Jim Allender - Nextdoor
comment: Reyman Foster with Classic Touch Painting and Repair did a great job on repairing the drywall on our ceiling. He explained his approach before starting, replaced drywall, taped and mudded the area. He did a perfect job of matching the texture. Best of all he cleaned up everything to perfection.
